title: "next and recommendation — seqconsistency"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## next

1. M: Phase 2 candidates in priority order: sourmash sequence-content comparison,
   reference-aware coverage comparison, processing-aware merged-read checks.
2. M: Recalibrate example thresholds with genuine between-run data before any
   production use.
3. L: Profile pysam BAM iteration; consider a native reader only with measured
   justification.

## recommendation

1. M: Treat COMPATIBLE results as technical assessments only; genotype-based
   identity verification (Phase 3) remains necessary for biological claims.
2. L: Keep `--sample-size` at or above the largest compared feature cost when
   comparing long-read lengths (Wasserstein precision depends on sample size).
